description: Sweep liveness cases (fleet-ops#9275). Each case feeds the RUN_LIVE_JQ filter from agent-dispatch.yml a `gh run view --json status,jobs` payload (job names, statuses and the run status as GitHub reports them; the name shape is from 0509 run 37258490012). want is whether the sweep counts the run as live. jobs are [name, status] pairs.

cases.name: queued-run-work-completed
cases.note: the #9275 bug: the run still reads queued while its work job ended, so the sweep waited an hour behind busy runners

cases.name: run-waiting-work-waiting
cases.note: waiting on the concurrency group is still live

cases.name: run-queued-no-jobs-yet
cases.note: a run dispatched a second ago has no jobs yet: live, so it is not requeued twice

cases.name: run-pending-only-skipped-callers
cases.note: no work job listed yet: fall back to the run's own status

cases.name: run-completed-work-failed
cases.note: real shape of 0509 run 37258490012: completed, work job failed

cases.name: matrix-own-leg-done-other-leg-running
cases.note: another issue's leg in the same run does not keep this issue live

cases.name: many-legs-none-named-one-running
cases.note: no leg carries the ref: any running work job keeps it live (fail toward not requeueing)
